summary: Wrote a 4-phase plan deciding the Phase 5 inner-fixpoint hoist in LiveFix.lean. The plan closes the one gap in the existing evidence (the small embedded witness was never A/B'd under the kernel, only under #eval), applies a pre-committed decision rule, and makes the module's recorded justification match what was measured. The expected branch is KEEP with a corrected docstring, since the hoist is encapsulated (zero references outside LiveFix.lean) and reverting buys no measured kernel gain; the REVERT branch is planned and scoped as well. Phase 3 carries typst/generated/status.typ in its own file scope because any Lean line-count change, including a pure docstring edit, is commit-blocking via .githooks/pre-commit.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan: kernel A/B gap closure, verdict under a pre-committed rule, LiveFix.lean justification correction with the commit-blocking surface, then inventory reconciliation plus the full gate set.
